summary: Tested subtitle upload feature for Creator Portal. Backend APIs working 100% (11/11 tests passed). Frontend UI for subtitle template download exists. CRITICAL BUG: Episode editor dialog cannot be accessed due to missing route /creator/series/:id - creators cannot upload subtitles via UI.

critical.issue: Clicking on series card navigates to /creator/series/{id} but this route is NOT defined in App.js, causing blank page. Episode editor dialog is unreachable.
critical.impact: Creators cannot access episode editor to upload subtitles

integration_issues.issue: Episode editor dialog exists in code (lines 748-917) with all subtitle upload UI, but cannot be triggered from any UI element due to missing series detail route

Verify episode editor dialog opens correctly after route fix
Test subtitle upload flow end-to-end after UI access is fixed
